statement: NO new numeric pre-launch budget was lawfully bindable in this lane.

binding_law_applied.gate_1: frozen authority already supplies the exact/floor/zero/max value; OR
binding_law_applied.gate_2: the repaired candidate's control flow makes the value exact and source-independent AT THE GOVERNED SCOPE, provable from code plus source-free court evidence.
binding_law_applied.gate_2_outcome: FAILS for every pending account. Every count lives in a SourceAccessBroker whose scope is one _decode() invocation. No per-source session owner binds a warrant source entry to exactly one decode, so no count is exact AT THE GOVERNED SCOPE.

fact_1_only: path_level_opens: application-owned, single open site in the whole C4 closure, capped pre-operation, with a positive-controlled static audit.
full_reads=0 on the selected route is now REFUSED BEFORE EXECUTION (decoder pins SourceAccessBudget(full_reads=0)).
byte_counts: reader_bytes is now enforceable via a bridge-safe limiter that never raises inside the read callback and surfaces a typed READER_BYTES_LIMIT_EXCEEDED at the outer boundary.

Every O1-C07 count the candidate does track is a separate typed counter with its own pre-operation cap, and the receipt publishes a measurement_basis per quantity plus a separation_law and the selected-route suppression disclosure.
what_did_advance.explicitly_not_an_advance: None of the above supplies a numeric pre-launch budget. Enforceability is not authority.

near_misses_explicitly_rejected.rejected_because: The broker CAN hold one handle and SourceAccessBudget.path_opens defaults to 1, but that default is documented as a POLICY CEILING, not a claim about expected behaviour. More fundamentally, the commission's named type GovernedSourceSession does not exist, the broker scope is one _decode call, there is no per-source session owner, and release has no finalizer. One open SITE is not one open PER SOURCE. See GOV-SCOPE-001.

near_misses_explicitly_rejected.value: reader_bytes / byte_counts ceiling from the synthetic carrier total (611 bytes on a 3-column x 60-row SAV)
near_misses_explicitly_rejected.rejected_because: Expressly forbidden by the commission and by sound accounting: a synthetic carrier total is not a warrant budget, and the real requirement is source-size dependent. See GOV-BYTES.

near_misses_explicitly_rejected.value: existence_checks / hash_passes / metadata_reads / reader_read_calls / chunk_reads = the exact count the candidate performs
near_misses_explicitly_rejected.rejected_because: These counts are exact per _decode invocation, not per warrant source entry. Gate 2 requires exactness AT THE GOVERNED SCOPE. The same scope defect blocks all of them uniformly.
Promotion would assert the pass count is exactly one per source. It is exactly one per decode. The HQ196 FLOOR 1 stands, still reviewer-flagged as derived from the C4B precondition.
